scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix backend ci
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec db psql -U app_user -d app_db -f /seeds/development.sql
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:frontend && npm run test:coverage:backend
scripts.test:coverage:backend: docker compose run --rm --build backend-test sh -c "npm run migrate && npm run test:coverage"
